objects: one complete-card-admitted physical card with positive-count ordinary fixed-mana Suspend
one ordinary spell object when cast
state_reads: ordinary type and compiled Flash timing
current legal cast targets and mandatory additional costs
costs: the hand special action pays only the fixed Suspend cost
the last-counter cast does not pay the mana cost, cannot select another alternative cost, and retains represented mandatory additional costs
timing: the hand action uses the timing at which the card could begin to be cast
the last-counter cast ignores ordinary type timing during trigger resolution
targets: targets are irrelevant to the hand action and chosen only for the later cast
no legal later target leaves the card exiled
choices: multiple same-controller upkeep triggers use ordinary controller ordering
hidden_information: the action is owner-private while the card is in hand
the exiled card and counters are public
physical and logical object IDs are never projected
apnap: owner-upkeep and last-counter triggers use the ordinary trigger batch
layers: the current-component owner gates the ability in hand and exile
a creature cast this way gains Haste until the first control change
replacement_effects: the initial exile move and time-counter placement use their canonical replacement-aware owners
copy: copied, granted, text-changed, and duplicate Suspend abilities remain unsupported
control_change: the Suspend Haste effect expires permanently at the first control change
zone_change: both triggers are pinned to the current public exile incarnation
a countered or declined last-counter trigger leaves the no-counter card in exile
source_leaves: leaving and returning before either trigger resolves makes the old trigger stale

variants: zero-cost and colored fixed Suspend costs

implementation.component: quorune.cast_lifecycles.FixedCastLifecycleSpec, quorune.suspend, quorune.rules.action_catalog, quorune.counter_placement, quorune.counter_removal, quorune.trigger_processing, quorune.selection.exile_cast.OneShotExileCastChoiceOwnerMixin, quorune.stack_resolution, and quorune.continuous_effect_state
implementation.supported_slice: One positive-count ordinary fixed-mana printed Suspend instance on a nonland complete card, using current timing, public exile counters, owner-upkeep removal, optional last-counter free casting, and creature Haste until control changes.

known_blockers: variable-count or variable-cost, hybrid, Phyrexian, snow, nonmana, modified, copied, granted, text-changed, duplicate, incomplete-card, inactive-face, and land forms remain unsupported
external exile-card counter removal outside current typed producers remains unmodeled
represented casting prohibitions beyond current typed timing authority remain blocked
Foretell, Plot, Escape, Rebound, Jump-start, and other staged-zone lifecycle families remain separate
